The '''Gymelo system''' was a part of the [[Bakura sector/Legends|Bakura sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained the celestial body [[Gymelo]]. In his youth, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bix Arden-Govia]] left behind his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], and signed on as a [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] out of Gymelo, eventually returning home from his travels<ref name="GATORW" /> at some point by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', [[Bix Arden-Govia]] had returned from his travels to [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Invasion of Bakura|invaded]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Gymelo [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square G-16.<ref name="TEA" />
